steps.rule: Exact duplicate listings (same flat posted again)
Villas, independent houses and penthouses (too few, a different market)
More than 5 bedrooms (too few to model)
Area under 200 or over 6,000 sq ft
Under 150 sq ft per bedroom (area or BHK mistyped)
Price per sq ft in the extreme 0.5% at either end
Price per sq ft over 3x above or below the locality's typical value
Locality too small or unclear to place in a zone
